browserSummary: Real Vite-server browser verification passed all 144 display selections across 9 scenarios and 72 recorded samples: 120 usable, 8 partial and 16 unavailable outputs, with no failures or acquisition attempts. Desktop 1440 × 1050, mobile 390 × 844, narrow 320 × 740 and tablet 800 × 1000 layouts were checked; the popup was checked at the three main widths. Saved preference, missing/stale source recovery, source-specific geometry/context, unchanged XYZ/roles, planning isolation and popup return all passed. A screenshot review caught an oversized inline view; the final compact layout keeps all three desktop XYZ estimate cells within the initial viewport.
